title: Combining Trait Bounds
goal: Require multiple traits using valid bound syntax.
hints: Rust uses a mathematical symbol to combine multiple required traits.
Look at how println! interacts with the value in show - default braces {} require Display.
explanation: Multiple trait bounds are joined using `+`, as in `Clone + Display`. Commas and `and` are syntax errors inside bound specifications. In `show`, printing with `{}` requires `Display`. Choosing `Debug` fails with `E0277` because `Display` is not satisfied, while choosing `Copy` fails with `E0277` because `String` does not implement `Copy`.
